summary: Asks the API to return thought summaries alongside the answer. Summaries come back as parts flagged `thought: true` on `generateContent`.
combines: Supported on: thinking-capable models, Gemini Developer API
Summaries are returned only if the model supports thoughts and actually produced enough reasoning. A thought block can arrive with a signature and no summary text.
You are billed for full thought tokens even though only the summary is returned.
On image models the thought content can include interim thought images as well as text.
supportedModels: gemini reasoning models with thinkingMode google-budget or google-level
note: It must be rendered as part of pipeline
